description: This is the main entry point for running a FastAPI backend application for the Quality Defect Tracking System. It configures the environment, manages sys.path to include the project root and optional virtual environment, and starts the server using uvicorn with parameters from environment variables.

methods.name: None _maybe_add_venv_site_packages(project_root: Path)
methods.description: Adds the virtual environment's site-packages directory to sys.path if it exists, as a fallback to ensure package imports work correctly in various environments.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Sets up sys.path, reads environment variables for host and port, and runs the FastAPI app via uvicorn.
